summary: Operator site (Saginaw Chippewa Indian Tribe / Soaring Eagle Properties) confirms 67 full-hookup sites with 30/50-amp, 50-ft concrete pads (sites 70-90 ft), showers, laundry, store, Wi-Fi, phone (989) 817-4803, Campspot booking; it posts no site rates (only a 2025 visitor/rental price sheet). Fees left as recorded from Campspot 2026-10-13 ($53.56-64.89 + 7.99% resort fee + $3.25 booking fee). Seasonal memberships are sold; Campspot books 39 of the 67 sites nightly (~42% not on the engine). Good Sam/military left (operator silent).
flags: Price gate: Campspot's cheapest site is $53.56/night (Tue, Oct 2026) plus a mandatory 7.99% 'Resort Fee' = $57.84/night before tax, over US$50. Nearest gateway: none within 40 km (Grand Rapids 105 km); the family has not stayed here. (Good Sam Park per the directory, 10% off would still leave ~$52.)
Rig rule: 'Class B Vans are prohibited. Other vans and truck campers are prohibited.' (info.html). EKKO is a Class C on a Ford Transit chassis, so it should qualify, but worth knowing.

Seasonal share: 'seasonal memberships available'; 39 of the 67 sites are bookable nightly on Campspot, so roughly 40% may be seasonal. Not tested further; the park is plainly nightly in character (casino/waterpark shuttle, themed weekends).
